title: GGML CPU Backend Initialization
summary: This module handles the initialization of the GGML CPU backend and provides functions to retrieve its device properties, including memory and capabilities. It sets up the CPU for efficient machine learning operations.

nodes.label: Initialize CPU Backend
nodes.title: Initialize CPU Backend
nodes.description: Sets up the CPU as a compute device for GGML operations, returning a handle to the initialized backend.

nodes.label: Retrieve CPU Device Properties
nodes.title: Get CPU Device Properties
nodes.description: Queries and returns detailed information about the CPU backend, such as its name, type, available memory, and supported capabilities.

nodes.label: GGML Core Framework
nodes.title: GGML Core Framework

nodes.label: System Hardware & OS
nodes.title: System Hardware & OS
nodes.description: The underlying operating system and physical hardware components that provide raw information about CPU resources and capabilities.

groups.title: CPU Device Information Retrieval
